title: CMake: extcap: Add Object Libraries in target_link_libraries
description:
We require CMake newer than 3.12, which added the ability to
specify Object Libraries directly in target_link_libraries.
This is better than the generator function not only because it's
easier to read but also because it propagates usage requirements
better, e.g. ssh-base can bear the PUBLIC requirements for libssh,
since ssh-base.h includes libssh.h.

notes.body: enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass
